notes: Adds a read-only viewer for the diocese's feast-day Mass schedule document (e.g. Assomption), reached only via a contextual link on a feast-affected card, hero, or results strip - never a standing menu item. Shows the diocese's own region/site table verbatim (no translation, no classification of entries), with a search box and a link back to the original PDF. Deep-links to the row for the card the user came from when a per-site mapping is known. Pipeline: ingest_feast_pdf.py now also emits data/feast-doc-<id>.json and its site_uid index, independently of the override-approval gate, so the facsimile is available even before overrides are approved. meta.feast_dates entries in master_corpus.json now carry an id field (toussaint-2026, noel-2026); no doc has been ingested for either yet, so the viewer has no live document to show in production until a real PDF is processed.
